pos.label: Position
pos.tooltip: Moves the sculpture around the hero

rotation.label: Rotation
rotation.tooltip: Turns the sculpture around its three axes

width.label: Ribbon width
width.tooltip: Higher values make the folded ribbon broader

thickness.label: Edge thickness
thickness.tooltip: Higher values thicken the machined ribbon edge

opening.label: Opening
opening.tooltip: Higher values widen the protected central space

copperColor.label: Lava
copperColor.tooltip: Sets the red orange molten surface color

edgeColor.label: Ember
edgeColor.tooltip: Sets the hottest inner edge color

brightness.label: Brightness
brightness.tooltip: Higher values make the metal reflections brighter

roughness.label: Roughness
roughness.tooltip: Higher values soften the studio reflections

filament.label: Molten light
filament.tooltip: Higher values brighten the flowing lava channels

amount.label: Opacity
amount.tooltip: Higher values make the sculpture more visible

quietCenter.label: Quiet center
quietCenter.tooltip: Higher values darken the area behind the headline

speed.label: Speed
speed.tooltip: Higher values accelerate the entire animation

breath.label: Flex
breath.tooltip: Higher values increase the gentle ribbon flex

breathSpeed.label: Flex speed
breathSpeed.tooltip: Higher values speed up the ribbon flex

blendMode.label: Blend Mode
blendMode.tooltip: Changes how the sculpture combines with the background

description: An animated ember and lava fold protects an empty interior, with flowing orange red light around a quiet center for hero typography
